question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who do you think is best for $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So then I'll meet you outside the cabin on Saturday morning... And trust me, $ZOE. When this is all over, you'll have made your choice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! I don't think you'd try to help me like this if you were still hung-up on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow, you really `are` nice! No wonder Howard likes you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, you really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] nice! No wonder Howard likes you.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just try to treat people how I want to be treated...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, I'll go with you. I accept!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great! We can even share stories about Howard's weird quirks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like how his `hair` is always scruffy in the back?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like how his [color=#3b78e2][i]hair[/i][/color] is always scruffy in the back?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hahaha! That's true! It is!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is going to be fun!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want to see some kind of evidence that you are actually over Howard...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You mean besides the fact that I'm `not` dating him, `haven't` pursued him, and am now nicely offering to help you with `your` romantic problems?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean besides the fact that I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] dating him, [color=#3b78e2][i]haven't[/i][/color] pursued him, and am now nicely offering to help you with [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] romantic problems?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you put it like that, it does sound like you're over him...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's because I am.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you going to accept my help or not? Because I'm seriously reconsidering...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I accept! I'll go!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ever since I went to `Labors of Love,` I've really started to appreciate being outdoors.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ever since I went to [color=#3b78e2][i]Labors of Love,[/i][/color] I've really started to appreciate being outdoors.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Labors of Love?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's a retreat for women with romantic problems. Hector's uncle Miguel hosts it at his cabin in the woods...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That might be the creepiest sentence I've ever heard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know! I know! I was skeptical at first too... But Hector told me his uncle was an expert on matters of the heart, and he was right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Miguel helped me see the right choice... That neither Howard nor Kenji was the right guy for me.
Linda absentmindedly plays with a small heart pendant around her neck.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I want to help you, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I feel like I really messed up when I couldn't decide between Howard or Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I see you heading down the same path and... And I just can't let you make the same mistake!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Miguel is training me to become a counselor... And I want to use what I've learned to help you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if it's a good idea for us to spend time together, Linda. I mean, you're Howard's ex!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I understand, but it's been a long time. I'm over Howard now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, then...
$ZOE finds Linda near the Lyle the Lizard statue...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! Wow, that was quick! I realized after I left my note that I had just signed it 'L.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay! As soon as I read it, I knew it was from you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: After your issues with Kenji and... And Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I figured you'd know what it's like to be torn between two guys.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm glad you came, $ZOE. I was afraid you might not want to see me because of my history with Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The truth is... If you want to give me advice... I guess it actually makes you `more` qualified.
nodes.text_bbcode: The truth is... If you want to give me advice... I guess it actually makes you [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] qualified.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's really thoughtful of you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus, it was either you or Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, Ms. Lee is crazy when it comes to guys!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: When I was waffling between Howard and Kenji, she told me I should choose Kenji because guys with motorcycles are the most dependable!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee! I once walked by her office when she was fighting with her boyfriend, and I heard her break up with him because he cheated on her in his dream!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hahahaha!
A light breeze blows through the air... Linda closes her eyes and takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing out here anyway?
$ZOE steps into Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Ms. Lee... Did you...?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Just the person I wanted to see!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I did get the right 'L'. What's your guy advice?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Men? Ha! Let me tell you, girl, lesson number one...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If you find your man is still emailing his ex-girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: `Accidentally` run over his golf clubs a couple times!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Accidentally[/i][/color] run over his golf clubs a couple times!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That's really specific.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Lesson two!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If he plans a `'nice'` date, and you get all dolled up, and then he takes you to a Cowboy Burger...
nodes.text_bbcode: If he plans a [color=#3b78e2][i]'nice'[/i][/color] date, and you get all dolled up, and then he takes you to a Cowboy Burger...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The next time he tries to kiss you, tell him cheap food gives you rabies! Then, start barking!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Ms. Lee, weren't you going to help me with `my` guy problems. You know, Howard and Matteo?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Ms. Lee, weren't you going to help me with [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] guy problems. You know, Howard and Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, `two` guys? Well, that's easy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] guys? Well, that's easy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm afraid to know why...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All you gotta do is get them in a cage together. Last one standing is the winner!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: That's how I met my second ex-husband!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Lee. I'll... Always remember the 'put them in a cage' idea.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anytime, Sharon!
$ZOE steps back into the hall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Definitely `the wrong` L. I hope it's not too late to find Linda.
nodes.text_bbcode: Definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]the wrong[/i][/color] L. I hope it's not too late to find Linda.

nodes.text: Outside, near the Lyle the Lizard statue, $ZOE finds Linda sitting on the grass in a cross-legged pose with her eyes closed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda? Was it you who left me this note?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course! Who else would it be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... You signed it 'L.'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Well, who did you think 'L' was? Ms. Lee?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Anyway, I didn't think you were going to come see me, so I started my meditation routine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... So, does that mean...?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Shh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How long...?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Shh!
After several uncomfortable minutes of silence, Linda opens her eyes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you always come out here to meditate?
Later that day, after class...
$ZOE opens up her locker and finds a note stuffed inside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Dear $ZOE, I can help you with your guy problems. Sincerely, L.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess everyone saw me run out of the cafeteria today...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But who is 'L'? 'L' could be Linda, but would Howard's ex-girlfriend `really` want to help me?
nodes.text_bbcode: But who is 'L'? 'L' could be Linda, but would Howard's ex-girlfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] want to help me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or it could be... Ms. Lee! She's crazy enough to do something like this...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You do?
Keith's voice rises in volume!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I can't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Keith! Shh...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Does Howard know you still have feelings for Matteo?!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE? Do you still have feelings for Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She totes does! That's why she sat so far away from him!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, if she sat any closer, she wouldn't have been able to help herself from drooling all over him!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am right here, you know this?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE...
$ZOE stands up and flees the cafeteria!
And runs crying right into one of the bathroom stalls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Could this day get any more embarrassing?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha! Girl in the guys' bathroom! Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I can imagine.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just going through a lot right now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's Howard and Matteo and the dance is coming up... It's all one big mess!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I wouldn't worry about it too much, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Whenever I start to get worried about how things are going with me and my girlfriend, Chelsea...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Something happens that just makes our relationship that much stronger!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awwww. Thanks, Keith! That makes me feel better!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa! Hold up... You have a girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: She lives in Canada! I've told you this like a hundred times!
As the guys argue, $ZOE can't help but look over at Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Promise me we'll make out later!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: No! Promise me!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are all very forthcoming...
$ZOE gets up and runs out of the cafeteria!
Howard plays the movie...
Thirty minutes in, $ZOE's eyes get heavy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Warm... So... Sleepy...
Suddenly she's standing in a beautiful Italian vineyard!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Buongiorno, signorina! You are my perfect grape! Come, let us ride horses together throughout the countryside!
Matteo and $ZOE ride alongside each other on two beautiful horses!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is so fun!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Do you know what is more fun than riding horses together?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Dancing forbidden dances in my villa!
$ZOE is wearing a beautiful dress! Matteo embraces her and begins to twirl her expertly around the dance floor!
He pulls her back to him and whispers in her ear...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are like a flower in the night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Matteo!
He spins her one more time, dipping her and then pulling her back up to him...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Come to the dance with me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Matteo! Of course I will!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Now I will kiss you as you are meant to be kissed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kiss me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Howard... I was having a dream.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Must have been `some` dream! Of course I'll kiss you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Must have been [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] dream! Of course I'll kiss you!

nodes.text: Howard leans across the couch and gives $ZOE a quick kiss.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry that the movie's so boring.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's okay... I... I think I should go home anyway...
The next day at lunch, $ZOE sits with Hector and Keith at one end of the Center Table...
Meanwhile, Matteo is sitting on the other end, completely surrounded by cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, guys.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, you sure you don't want to sit next to Mr. Hot Guy over there?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This sucks, man. Before he showed up, I used to eat lunch `with` hot girls. Now I eat lunch `kind of near` hot girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: This sucks, man. Before he showed up, I used to eat lunch [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] hot girls. Now I eat lunch [color=#e23b3b][i]kind of near[/i][/color] hot girls.

nodes.text: Nicole spills her drink on Matteo's shirt!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whoops! I'm such a klutz! Here, let me dry that off for you!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Should you maybe use a towel instead of your hand?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ha! This is America, Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not understand.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Maybe he should just take his shirt `off...` That would make him the most dry!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe he should just take his shirt [color=#3b78e2][i]off...[/i][/color] That would make him the most dry!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! Take it off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector, aren't you worried about Amanda over there?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nah. She just likes belly buttons.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Matteo, I just thought I should mention... No one's asked me to the Valentine's Dance yet...
Jacob scoffs from a nearby table...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What?! I asked you yesterday... And you said `yes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! I asked you yesterday... And you said [color=#e23b3b][i]yes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Shut up, Jacob! Do `not` ruin this for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up, Jacob! Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] ruin this for me!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am very sorry, but I have my eye set on someone else for the dance.
Matteo shoots $ZOE a quick glance...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I've gotta say, Matteo, Centerscore has gotten a lot more fun since you came here...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You're like the most popular guy in school!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You should run for President! It'd be way better to have a hot guy than Justin!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You'd have my vote!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ha! That's funny! Everyone knows Matteo can't be President since he wasn't born in America!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh, what? He's not running for President of `America...` He can totally be School President!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, what? He's not running for President of [color=#3b78e2][i]America...[/i][/color] He can totally be School President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?! But I need Ben to become...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Girls! Stop crowding Matteo! All of you come over this way `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Girls! Stop crowding Matteo! All of you come over this way [color=#3b78e2][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As Jessica pries the girls away from Matteo, Keith whispers across the table to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I know all this attention Matteo's getting has to be eating you up inside. After all, you did kiss him in Paris!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Do you still have, you know, feelings for him?

nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: More popcorn! I need more popcorn!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure...
Howard scoops some more popcorn into $ZOE's bowl.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought you said something else...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just watch the movie, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! Here you go!
Howard gives $ZOE some more popcorn!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: More?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you okay, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm fine!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes... Let's just watch the movie, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay...
$ZOE concentrates on her surroundings...
She feels the breeze as it softly blows against her skin. She hears the delightful chirping of the birds in the trees. And she takes deep, deep breaths...
After about twenty minutes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was wonderful. I really felt like I had become a part of this meadow...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Did you have any revelations about Howard and Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... The only thing I learned is how much I have to concentrate just to `stop` thinking about them!
nodes.text_bbcode: No... The only thing I learned is how much I have to concentrate just to [color=#3b78e2][i]stop[/i][/color] thinking about them!

nodes.text: When $ZOE opens her eyes, she sees that she's in a room in the cabin...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You passed out, and you kept mumbling, 'Monkey, tell me what I've won!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had... A weird vision.
$ZOE sees a small heart pendant resting on the table next to her. She picks it up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't this yours?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, I still have mine. It's part of the retreat... Miguel gives these to everyone.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: He said after the 'normal' steam room you'd probably have good use for it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The pendant is supposed to symbolize your own heart... And you give it to whomever it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's why you still have yours?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I just haven't found the right guy yet.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What about you, though? Did you figure out what you're going to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did... I know exactly what to do!

nodes.text: I'm sorry... I forgot who I was talking to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't have to be so mean!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I know, I know. It's been a long day for both of us.
The monkey holds up a small tissue for $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: I'm so hungry... There weren't any cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You are seriously obsessed!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Anyway, what do you think happens now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know. Maybe in all this steam I'll see the silhouette of the guy I'm supposed to be with... What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda? Hello?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: She can't hear you. You're in my world now!
Sitting nearby is a monkey eating a banana.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are you?!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I'm your Spirit Animal. I'm supposed to guide you and blah blah blah... But, whatever.
The monkey tosses his banana aside and starts to walk away.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: You're clearly not worthy of my guidance.
As the monkey walks off, $ZOE starts to cry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I can't take this! Every time I think I'm going to learn how to deal with my feelings, I just find out that I'm out of luck, or that it's even more complicated, or that the monkey won't help me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that last part sounds weird, but cut me some slack, okay? It's been a long day...
The monkey turns around and comes back to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE. I thought that the same 'tough love' style that worked with your boyfriend would work with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're... You're Howard's Spirit Animal too? Isn't that a sign that he and I are really meant to be with each other?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Well, to be honest, no. There aren't very many Spirit Animals, so there's a lot of overlap.
$ZOE sobs.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I mean, uh, `yes!` That's a `very` good sign! Just stop crying, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, uh, [color=#3b78e2][i]yes![/i][/color] That's a [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] good sign! Just stop crying, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why should I? I know that I need to choose someone now, and I know that my feelings for both Howard and Matteo are true, but there's nothing I can do!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I... I can help you, $ZOE. There is one more lesson to learn.
The monkey snaps his fingers and...
$ZOE finds herself on the set of a game show! The monkey is standing next to her, dressed in a tux and holding an oversized microphone.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Welcome, $ZOE! This is the final and only round of `Howard Or Matteo!` Yes! It's the game show where just one contestant, coincidentally named $ZOE, must make an impossible decision!
nodes.text_bbcode: Welcome, $ZOE! This is the final and only round of [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard Or Matteo![/i][/color] Yes! It's the game show where just one contestant, coincidentally named $ZOE, must make an impossible decision!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Mr. Sprinkles, please show us what's behind door number one!
A small kitten slowly nudges open a huge door with a large '1' on it.
On the other side, Howard is sitting in a nice-looking car.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: It's a new car! That's right! This safe, comfortable, reliable vehicle is piloted by none other than your current boyfriend, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! Pick me, and I'll always be there for you. I'll love you... Unconditionally.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: What more could a girl want?!
$ZOE sees Matteo standing in front of a huge door with a large '2' on it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about that door? Why is Matteo standing `in front` of it?
nodes.text_bbcode: What about that door? Why is Matteo standing [color=#3b78e2][i]in front[/i][/color] of it?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Funny you should ask! That brings us to the crux of our show! Take it away, Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hello, beautiful $ZOE! I am your Italian dream... `Within a dream!` Pick my door, and you will get...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello, beautiful $ZOE! I am your Italian dream... [color=#e23b3b][i]Within a dream![/i][/color] Pick my door, and you will get...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, life with me would be a mystery! A great surprise! A box of chocolates without a guide to tell you what is in each chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: What's it going to be, $ZOE? Door number one or door number two?
Voices call from the audience...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pick Howard! He's got the best gas-mileage!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Pick Matteo! If you don't, I'll make out with him every day!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Seriously, how can you say no to a guy who serenades you?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Pick the one with the belly button!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Well, there you have it, the audience has weighed in. Now it's time for the moment of truth...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I think I know who to pick... It's been right in front of me this whole time. I love Howard, but I have feelings for Matteo...
The monkey snaps his fingers, and the game show set disappears.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I told you that you had one last lesson to learn. Can you tell me what that lesson is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

options.label: I must give up the unknown!

nodes.text: Miguel sits back down, excited.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: You mean, the magical... I mean, the `normal` steam room?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, the magical... I mean, the [color=#e23b3b][i]normal[/i][/color] steam room?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Well, for 'legal' reasons, I'm not allowed to let you inside there, all because of some stupid, 'government' 'officials' who think it's 'unsafe.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was an uncomfortable number of air quotations.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Never mind those...
He leans forward, whispering...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: I designed the steam room a long time ago because a mystic told me he felt an awesome power emanating from the earth there.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Now, people claim to have visions after they sit in it... But you didn't hear it from me...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Tonight, when everyone's asleep, I will be very careful about leaving all the doors `locked.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tonight, when everyone's asleep, I will be very careful about leaving all the doors [color=#e23b3b][i]locked.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He shoots them a small wink...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: `'Locked.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Locked.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks, Miguel.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks for keeping things so, um, 'secure'.
That night, $ZOE and Linda creep into the steam room. Soon, steam is swirling around them...
Miguel sits back down, concerned.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: You don't know what makes `love` magical?
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't know what makes [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] magical?

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: You don't about the most incredible force upon this planet, our Mother Earth?
Linda gives $ZOE a small kick under the table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: I'd be in pain too, if I didn't know...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Luckily, we have several hours before lights out to get you up to speed on everything related to love!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think that's necessary...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: It's no trouble. I'm going to be making carrot juice anyway!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Gross...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: We'll begin by discussing chemistry...
Several hours later, as the girls try to keep their eyes open...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: And that brings me to the 'L' in the M.I.G.U.E.L. method, which of course stands for...?

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Which of course `stands for...?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which of course [color=#e23b3b][i]stands for...?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Love?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda?

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: `L`lama! Be soft like a llama! Haven't you girls been paying `any` attention?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]L[/i][/color]lama! Be soft like a llama! Haven't you girls been paying [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] attention?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're sorry, Miguel. It's just so late.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Yeah, I can tell when I'm not appreciated.
Miguel gets up and storms off.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Nice going. What did you think was going to happen when you asked a love expert what makes love magical?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't realize he'd talk for that long... Or that making carrot juice was such a slow process!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, at least we know what we have to do...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We do?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I understand if you forgot when Miguel looked at the door since it happened several `hours` ago, but that's our answer!
nodes.text_bbcode: I understand if you forgot when Miguel looked at the door since it happened several [color=#3b78e2][i]hours[/i][/color] ago, but that's our answer!

nodes.text: That night, Linda and $ZOE sneak into the cabin and go through the door...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a steam room!
Soon, steam is swirling around them...
She struggles to find her way to the surface, but every time she thinks she's found it, she ends up diving deeper into the freezing water...
Suddenly, she hears another splash!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda?!
A silhouette swims through the water, grabs $ZOE, and hoists her toward the surface with huge, strong hands!
$ZOE's consciousness begins to fade...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I knew Linda was a great swimmer, but...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: $ZOE? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phil?! You're... You're a werewolf?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you saved me!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Of course I saved you. I've always loved you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I just... I couldn't do anything about it since you've always been with... With `Howard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I just... I couldn't do anything about it since you've always been with... With [color=#e23b3b][i]Howard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't understand. How come you never said anything?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Would you have believed me?
Consciousness begins to return to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: $ZOE? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda?! Phil pulled me out of the water and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And... And he's a werewolf!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's got fangs and fur and `abs!`
nodes.text_bbcode: He's got fangs and fur and [color=#3b78e2][i]abs![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And how come you're just sitting there?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you hearing yourself?! Werewolves?! $ZOE, `I` was the one who pulled you from the water...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you hearing yourself?! Werewolves?! $ZOE, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was the one who pulled you from the water...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... That's... That's not what I remember at all...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on... Let's get you home.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean 'home', as in, back to the cabin, right?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, I mean `home` home, $ZOE. You've had enough for one weekend.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I mean [color=#3b78e2][i]home[/i][/color] home, $ZOE. You've had enough for one weekend.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You can figure out what to do about Howard and Matteo later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh oh.
At school that week...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE?! Why haven't you been answering any of my calls?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, whatever your name is... But my heart belongs to someone else...
Phil turns the corner and stops when $ZOE spots him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phil!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Oh no! Not this again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you fight vampires? Where does all that extra fur go? How often do you workout?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: For the last time, I am `not` a werewolf!
nodes.text_bbcode: For the last time, I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a werewolf!

nodes.text: Oh no! It looks like $ZOE's become obsessed with Phil! Instead of solving her dilemma, it's clear...
A few moments later, Linda wraps a towel around $ZOE as she emerges shivering from the water.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: S-s-s-so cold!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Who did you see?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It d-d-d-didn't help! I saw b-b-b-both of them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Both?
$ZOE nods.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That means your feelings for both of them are true!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I don't think I'll be able to help you! This is beyond my expertise!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Th-th-th-that's okay, Linda! At least I looked at the r-r-r-right time!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on... Let's get you warm back at the cabin. I think Miguel's going to want to hear about this!
After a long walk back to the cabin, $ZOE and Linda sit by a fire and tell Miguel the results of $ZOE's dive.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Shoot... I've never heard of a diver seeing `two` reflections. You're in one hairy pickle.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shoot... I've never heard of a diver seeing [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] reflections. You're in one hairy pickle.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is there anything she can do?

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Hmmm...
Miguel's eyes dart for an instant to a door in the corner of the room...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: I'm... I'm afraid not, girls.
Miguel starts to get up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mr. Alonzo, before you go... Do you think you could tell us...

nodes.prompt: Do you think you could tell us...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you think you could tell us...

nodes.text: $ZOE opens her eyes after the third second!
In that moment, time seems to freeze...
She sees an image in the water...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!
But then, a second image forms...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `And` Matteo?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] Matteo?!

nodes.text: Time unfreezes, and she pierces the water like a knife!
$ZOE keeps her eyes shut.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! How much time was that?!
She opens her eyes, but it's too late! Before she can see anything, she splashes into the water!
$ZOE keeps her eyes shut. She can hear the wind screaming against her face as she dives!
Another second passes...
$ZOE keeps her eyes shut. The wind rushes against her face!
Another second passes...
$ZOE opens her eyes too early! As the water rushes up, she looks for an image, but all she sees is her own reflection!
She splashes into the water!
$ZOE tries to concentrate on her surroundings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I picture a rock. With moss on it... That's nice. 'Moss' is a funny word.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Moss'... It starts with the letter 'M'... Matteo starts with the letter 'M'...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...And I kissed Matteo!
$ZOE's eyes pop open!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I can tell you're struggling... Try again.
$ZOE closes her eyes again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can hear the water from the lake lapping against the shore...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And some birds on the lake... What kind of birds are they?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They sound like geese...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they could be ducks!
$ZOE's eyes pop open again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard loves ducks!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow. Not only was that super weird, but you are `really` full of conflict!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. Not only was that super weird, but you are [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] full of conflict!

nodes.text: On Saturday morning, Linda meets $ZOE outside Hector's uncle's cabin in the woods...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Glad you made it, $ZOE! There's Miguel!
A stocky man holding a glass of wheatgrass juice stands on the front porch of the cabin...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Linda, so good to see you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Miguel! This is $ZOE! She's having romantic problems, just like I was!

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Oh, well, that's too bad!

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Wish I could stay and help, but I'll be off in the woods conducting an advanced meditation seminar. Feel free to use the cabin if you need it,

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks. I think we're going to start with meditation too.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Far out!

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: As someone really mystical once said, 'Only when you've found harmony `within` will you be able to find love `without.`'
nodes.text_bbcode: As someone really mystical once said, 'Only when you've found harmony [color=#e23b3b][i]within[/i][/color] will you be able to find love [color=#e23b3b][i]without.[/i][/color]'

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: And in case you get hungry, I'll set aside some cupcakes for you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooh! Cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What do you say, $ZOE? Ready?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.
After a short hike, $ZOE follows Linda to a quiet lakeside spot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's so beautiful! I've always loved nature.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Have you ever meditated before?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... I don't really know how...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's pretty easy, `unless` you're filled with a lot of conflict. All you have to do is sit like this.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's pretty easy, [color=#3b78e2][i]unless[/i][/color] you're filled with a lot of conflict. All you have to do is sit like this.

nodes.text: Linda sits cross-legged on a flat spot on the grass, and $ZOE sits next to her.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now just close your eyes and try to focus on what's around you...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Feel the soft-blowing breeze... Listen to the songs of the birds... Breathe in the pure air...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I can do that...
$ZOE closes her eyes...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I think I know what this means...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You have to make a choice `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have to make a choice [color=#3b78e2][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Otherwise, you'll be so wrapped up in this triangle, you won't be able to concentrate on anything else!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want that... But I still don't know what I'm supposed to do about my feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love Howard, but I can't get Matteo out of my mind!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I have an idea that might help... Come on!
Linda hikes along a trail at the edge of the lake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about the cupcakes?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Cupcakes can wait! Besides, you haven't gotten your answer yet!
$ZOE gets up and follows Linda up the trail...
Which leads them to a precipice overlooking the water! $ZOE hugs the cliff wall!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't like the looks of this!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look, I know it's scary... We are `really` high up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I know it's scary... We are [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] high up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not helping!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But True Heart's Bluff could be the answer to your problem!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How?! Is terror supposed to shock me into choosing a guy?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... The bluff is actually kind of a legend around here...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: First, you're supposed to dive into the water...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No way! Never!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...And then, just before you splash in, you'll see a reflection of whoever you have true feelings for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Really?
$ZOE takes a few cautious steps toward the edge and peeks down...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eeep! It's even higher than I thought!
Linda puts a comforting hand on $ZOE's shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: When I dove last year, I didn't see anyone reflected. I didn't see Howard `or` Kenji.
nodes.text_bbcode: When I dove last year, I didn't see anyone reflected. I didn't see Howard [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Linda, I don't mean to be rude, but `of course` you didn't see anyone!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, Linda, I don't mean to be rude, but [color=#3b78e2][i]of course[/i][/color] you didn't see anyone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All you should see is your `own` reflection!
nodes.text_bbcode: All you should see is your [color=#3b78e2][i]own[/i][/color] reflection!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's what I'm saying, $ZOE... I didn't see anyone, `including` my own reflection!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what I'm saying, $ZOE... I didn't see anyone, [color=#3b78e2][i]including[/i][/color] my own reflection!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: True Heart's Bluff showed me an image... It showed me who I had true feelings for at the time...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And what it showed me was `no one!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And what it showed me was [color=#3b78e2][i]no one![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! That `really` happened?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! That [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] happened?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I swear...
$ZOE takes another peek over the edge...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait! There's something I have to tell you before you dive...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: According to the legend, you have to look at the water at exactly the right moment...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You can't look too early... The legend says you can't rush into love.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And you can't look too late... The legend says you have to also respect love.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is an incredibly demanding magic jumping spot!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, I'm not the one who made the rules.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I guess I can always jump again if I don't get it right the first time.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh. I'm not going to like this, am I?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: According to the legend, those who look at the wrong time are punished.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Punished? Punished how?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't know... Miguel wouldn't tell me. He just kept muttering something about `'el lobo'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know... Miguel wouldn't tell me. He just kept muttering something about [color=#3b78e2][i]'el lobo'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All... All I know is that I'm confused about what I'm feeling.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I always thought if you loved a guy, it would be impossible to feel anything for another guy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And now that I think I feel something for Matteo, I can't tell if that means I'm wrong about my feelings for him or... Or that I don't really love Howard...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's up to you... I chose to dive, but you don't have to...
$ZOE removes her sweater and plants herself just a few steps from the edge!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to jump right now, before I get even more scared! When am I supposed to look?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: After three seconds! You can do it!
Without hesitating, $ZOE runs to the edge and leaps off into a perfect dive!
One second passes!
$ZOE keeps her eyes shut. The wind rushes against her face!
Another second passes...
$ZOE keeps her eyes shut. She can hear the wind screaming against her face as she dives!
Another second passes...
A few moments later, Linda wraps a towel around $ZOE as she emerges shivering from the water.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: S-s-s-so cold!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Who did you see?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It d-d-d-didn't help! I saw b-b-b-both of them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Both?
$ZOE nods.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That means your feelings for both of them are true!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I don't think I'll be able to help you! This is beyond my expertise!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Th-th-th-that's okay, Linda! At least I looked at the r-r-r-right time!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on... Let's get you warm back at the cabin. I think Miguel's going to want to hear about this!
After a long walk back to the cabin, $ZOE and Linda sit by a fire and tell Miguel the results of $ZOE's dive.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Shoot... I've never heard of a diver seeing `two` reflections. You're in one hairy pickle.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shoot... I've never heard of a diver seeing [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] reflections. You're in one hairy pickle.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is there anything she can do?

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Hmmm...
Miguel's eyes dart for an instant to a door in the corner of the room...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: I'm... I'm afraid not, girls.
Miguel starts to get up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mr. Alonzo, before you go... Do you think you could tell us...

nodes.prompt: Do you think you could tell us...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you think you could tell us...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to jump right now, before I get even more scared! When am I supposed to look?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: After three seconds! You can do it!
Without hesitating, $ZOE runs to the edge and leaps off into a perfect dive!
One second passes!
The following week at lunch, Matteo is once again being hounded by girls, when $ZOE approaches... The girls fall silent.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Buongiorno, signorina!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can totally tell. This is going to be, like, the best! Let me get my phone so I can take a pic!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ha! Here comes the drool!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... Can I talk to you alone for a second?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aww, they ruined my fun!
$ZOE leads Matteo out into the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've been thinking almost non-stop these last few days about how I feel about you, Matteo, and it's really put me through a lot...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am so sorry for you to feel this way...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I couldn't tell you before that I didn't have feelings for you, Matteo, because... Because I `did` have feelings for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I couldn't tell you before that I didn't have feelings for you, Matteo, because... Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] have feelings for you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `do` have feelings for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] have feelings for you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is wonderful!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let me finish...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What more is there to say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have feelings for you, Matteo, but... I `love` Howard! He's the guy I want to be with!
nodes.text_bbcode: I have feelings for you, Matteo, but... I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] Howard! He's the guy I want to be with!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And even though I know going out with you would be fun and adventurous, the truth is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to give up on something that is so certainly amazing, not even for the thrill of something completely new...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, I've already had so much fun and so many adventures with Howard already...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And yeah, we have our boring moments, our off nights, but what established couple doesn't?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you've had your heart set on me, but I'm telling you now... I'm certain... Howard is everything I want!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Now I `really` see...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] see...

nodes.text: Matteo turns away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo, wait!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You have changed your mind?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! But I have an idea!
After class...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You remember Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Buongiorno!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Matteo, I'm sure you remember my cousin, Sam! She's single!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is by far the most embarrassing thing you've ever done to me.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You have the most beautiful, radiant skin of any girl I've ever gazed upon...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never mind!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh hey, have either of you guys seen Howard? I've been looking for him everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, he went home early for something... He wouldn't say what...
A half hour later, $ZOE knocks on Howard's front door... He opens it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?! Why is your face covered in frosting?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...
The twins scamper out from behind Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're making you cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard Cupcakes are the most fun because they explode when you cook them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess the surprise is out! We know how much you like cupcakes... And you're always baking them for everyone else...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I figured I'd try to bake some for you...
Howard holds up a lopsided piece of ill-defined pastry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd give this to you, but I think it now qualifies as a hazardous material.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard!
$ZOE wraps her arms around Howard in a big frosting-covered hug!
When they part, $ZOE gives Howard the heart pendant from the retreat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's mine to give to the person I love. That's you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I love you! I can't wait for the Valentine's Dance!
They kiss!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ew, gross!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Come on, you guys! We wanna make more cupcake explosions!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Looks like $ZOE's made her choice, and it certainly feels like the right one!
You played a great game! You helped $ZOE discover her true feelings out in the great outdoors, and through her dilemma, she learned the final lesson...
Sometimes you have to make sacrifices for the ones you love...

Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: On Monday morning, $ZOE steps into the Auto Shop.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What's up, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you have anything that can smash this heart pendant?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Did someone say smash?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, pretty much everything in here can accomplish the job...
Kenji takes the heart pendant and tosses it into a machine. He turns it on. A few seconds later...
`Crrrrrrruncch!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Crrrrrrruncch![/b]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That's my favorite sound!
Kenji takes out a small metal container underneath the machine and pours out $ZOE's heart pendant. It's now broken into a thousand pieces!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Kenji! Here's one for you!
$ZOE hands Kenji one of the pieces...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Why are you giving me this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I learned a valuable lesson... I have an unknown future with everyone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Was that it? I can't quite remember...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't forget you either, Ryan! Here you go!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sweet!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What does this get me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't `get` you anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: It doesn't [color=#3b78e2][i]get[/i][/color] you anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just means that from now on, a part of my heart belongs to you.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Barf.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So, then... I could ask `part` of you to go to the dance with me?
nodes.text_bbcode: So, then... I could ask [color=#e23b3b][i]part[/i][/color] of you to go to the dance with me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Absolutely! That part of me accepts!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And, uh... I could, too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! I accept!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This is gross...
Later that day, $ZOE hands some of her heart pieces out to the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You realize this has no value, right? It's just a chunk of worthless metal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It gets you a date with me to the dance! I could take it back if you want!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Stay away from my worthless metal!
$ZOE hands one to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's okay, $ZOE, I don't want to be an enabler.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't take this. It just encourages you to divide your love up so much that eventually...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It doesn't mean anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hadn't thought of it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's why I love big!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: When you promise to love everyone, eventually, well... Someone gets their feelings hurt real bad!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh!
Howard comes marching down the hall!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How could you, $ZOE?! I hear you have over `two hundred` dates to the Valentine's Dance?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How could you, $ZOE?! I hear you have over [color=#e23b3b][i]two hundred[/i][/color] dates to the Valentine's Dance?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There aren't even two hundred guys at this school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those guys at the gas station were really nice!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Good. Bye. $ZOE.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Good. Bye. $ZOE.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard turns and storms off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard? Howard?!
Uh oh! Looks like $ZOE didn't quite learn the right lesson! Play again and see if you can sort out her dilemma!

Later that week, Matteo is out on a date with Sam! Sam takes a big bite out of a piece of bread.
Signorina, I cannot move my eyes from yours!
Every motion that you make is like a testament to beauty!
Mmmmfff!
She swallows her bread.
Thanks... But this is our `first` date, Matteo. Take it easy.
What do you mean, my perfect bumblebee?
Well, you don't have to come on like a steamroller.
Relax! Let's find out if we even like each other first.
I do not understand.
Ugh. Just because we're on a date doesn't mean we're meant for each other.
How do you fall in love then if you do not declare it right away?
Wow... Um... Do you know what it means to 'play the field'?
Like a soccer field? Of course! I am always the striker!
`No!` No sports!
What I mean is... The girl you were with in Italy...
Adrianna, the light of my life!
So, you were completely crazy for her for a while and then $ZOE showed up in France...
$ZOE, the light of my life!
Crazy again! And now, you're here with me...
Samantha, the light of my...
Hmm, I seem to have multiple lights of my life...
What I'm saying is, instead of throwing yourself at me, why don't you go on a bunch of different dates and see what you like?
That is an option?!
Of course!
But this feels very much like a girl trap.
It's not a 'girl trap', believe me? Look, I know about matters of the heart.
And even though I do find your dimples irresistible, the `last` thing I want is you doting on me every second of the day like a puppy dog.
I see it. You want me to play the field first before I steamroll you.
Uh... Close enough.
So then there will be no kissing tonight?
I didn't say that.
I like this.
Now, talk to me about anything that `isn't` sports!
Deal. I will talk to you about my second favorite thing after soccer...
The beauty of my country, Italy.
I like this.
Looks like Sam's planted a new idea in Matteo's head! What will it mean for the future of Centerscore?

nodes.text: After school one day, $ZOE and Howard are eating together in $ZOE's house.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think of the cupcakes I baked, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Delicious as always, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Baking always makes the house so warm!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, I was thinking before the Valentine's Dance this year, that we'd go back to `The Heaaaaart of the Sea...`
nodes.text_bbcode: So, I was thinking before the Valentine's Dance this year, that we'd go back to [color=#e23b3b][i]The Heaaaaart of the Sea...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember how much fun we had acting like pirates and eating Plank Steak?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Um... Yeah, that was fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool, then... So... What do you want to do tonight?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there anything you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... I can't really think of anything...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Want to watch another movie?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure.
$ZOE and Howard sit on the couch together, a bowl of popcorn between them...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you like romantic movies, $ZOE, so I was thinking we could watch `More Amore!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you like romantic movies, $ZOE, so I was thinking we could watch [color=#e23b3b][i]More Amore![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, I need more...
